DECLARE
 szDonorID varchar2(10);
 szProcedureCode varchar2(5);
 szDonationType varchar2(5);
 szCollDate date;
 szEligStatus varchar2(5);
 szDeferDate date;
 szDeferReason varchar2(50);
 szInterType varchar2(10);
 tmr timer;
 
 cursor cur_procdesc is
 select initcap(description)
 from valid_proc_codes
 where procedure_code = :valid_proc_codes.procedure_code;

BEGIN

 If :valid_proc_codes.procedure_code is not null then

 open cur_procdesc;
 fetch cur_procdesc
 into :valid_proc_codes.proc_code_desc;
 :valid_proc_codes.proc_code_desc:=:valid_proc_codes.procedure_code||' - '||
 :valid_proc_codes.proc_code_desc;
 if cur_procdesc%NOTFOUND then
 :valid_proc_codes.proc_code_desc := 'Not available';
 end if;

 if cur_procdesc%ISOPEN then
 close cur_procdesc;
 end if;



 szDonorID := :donors.donor_id;
 szProcedureCode := :valid_proc_codes.procedure_code;
 szDonationType := 'AL';
 szCollDate := sysdate;

 don_core.check_eligibility(szDonorID,
 szProcedureCode,
 szDonationType,
 szCollDate,
 szEligStatus,
 szDeferDate,
 szInterType,
 szDeferReason);

 :valid_proc_codes.deferral_date := szDeferDate;
 :valid_proc_codes.deferral_reason := szDeferReason;

 if szEligStatus = 'Y' then
 :valid_proc_codes.elig_status := 'Yes';
 :global.status:='Y'; ---(it is deferral flag: 'Y' means good donor)
 else
 :valid_proc_codes.elig_status := 'No';
 end if;

 /* Removed as flashing was causing problems for laptop lookup.
 if upper(szDeferReason) like '%DEFER%' then
 if id_null(find_timer('DEFER')) then
 tmr := create_timer('DEFER',500,REPEAT);
 set_item_property('VALID_PROC_CODES.ELIG_STATUS',visual_attribute,'DEFERRAL_FLASH');
 end if;
 else
 if not id_null(find_timer('DEFER')) then
 delete_timer('DEFER');
 set_item_property('VALID_PROC_CODES.ELIG_STATUS',visual_attribute,'NO_DEFERRAL');
 end if;
 */
 
 
 if szInterType in ('PERMD','TEMPD','HOLDS') then
 display_item('VALID_PROC_CODES.ELIG_STATUS','DEFERRAL_FLASH');
 else
 display_item('VALID_PROC_CODES.ELIG_STATUS','GREEN_FLASH');
 end if;

 End if;

END;

 :ctrl_blk_1.disp_total:=to_number(:global.total_found);

 END IF;

 -- Check the record is present in the new donor temp table

 if v_found='NO' then -- IF not found get from donors table
 get_from_donors;
 end if;

 go_block('donors');
 :system.message_level:=10;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_donor_id:=:find_donors.donor_id;
 execute_query;
 
 :global.status:=null;
 go_block('valid_proc_codes');
 execute_query;

 go_block('donor_interdictions1');
 execute_query;

 :system.message_level:=0;

 set_item_property('button_block.pb_previous_donation',enabled,property_true);
 set_item_property('button_block.pb_comm_log',enabled,property_true);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.s_donor_id',enabled,property_false); 
 go_item('valid_proc_codes.deferral_date');
 
 copy_values;
 go_item('new_donor.donor_id');

ELSIF :GLOBAL.action='NEW' then

 :global.status:='Y'; -- Not to print the 'D' on the card. This is used in valid_proc_codes post-query
 :new_donor.donor_id:='NEW';
 
 set_item_property('button_block.pb_next_donor',enabled,property_false);
 set_item_property('button_block.pb_prev_donor',enabled,property_false);

 go_block('new_donor');
 check_new_donor_table(v_found);

 If v_found='NO' then

 :new_donor.first_name :=:find_donors.first_name;
 -- :new_donor.date_of_birth:=:find_donors.date_of_birth;
 :new_donor.gender :=:find_donors.gender;
 /* :new_donor.ssn :=:find_donors.ssn;
 :new_donor.ssn:= substr(:new_donor.ssn,1,3)||'-'||
 substr(:new_donor.ssn,4,2)||'-'||
 substr(:new_donor.ssn,6,4); for double entry */
 end if;
 go_item('new_donor.ssn');

END IF;

 -- Calculate the donor age added by Edwin on 08-10-2000
 if :new_donor.date_of_birth is not null then 
 :new_donor.age_yrs:=floor(months_between(sysdate,:new_donor.date_of_birth)/12);
 :new_donor.age_months:=floor(mod(months_between(sysdate,:new_donor.date_of_birth),12));
 end if;

 if :global.printer_id is not null then
 :ctrl_blk_1.printer_id:=:global.printer_id;
 end if;

 if :global.drive_id is not null then
 :ctrl_blk_2.disp_drive_id:=:global.drive_id;
 end if;
 :system.message_level:=0;
END;

DECLARE
 v_name varchar2(100);
 v_address varchar2(100);
 v_house_phone varchar2(12);
 v_buss_phone varchar2(12);
 v_extension number;

 v_donation number;

 v_ytd number:=0;
 v_life number:=0;
 v_gallon_file varchar2(30);
 szChkDgt varchar2(5);
 v_temp_unit_id varchar2(15);
 
BEGIN

 
 select b.last_name||', '||b.first_name||' '||b.middle_name,
 c.street_name|| decode(c.suite_apt,null,' ','#'||c.suite_apt)||d.city||' '||d.state||' '||d.zip,
 decode(c.h_area_code,null,'',c.h_area_code||'-')||decode(c.h_phone_no,null,'',substr(c.h_phone_no,1,3)||'-'||substr(c.h_phone_no,4,4)),
 decode(c.d_area_code,null,'',c.d_area_code||'-')||decode(c.d_phone_no,null,'',substr(c.d_phone_no,1,3)||'-'||substr(c.d_phone_no,4,4)),c.extension 
 INTO v_name,v_address,v_house_phone,v_buss_phone,v_extension
 from donors b,donor_addresses c,valid_city_state d
 where b.donor_id=:donors.donor_id and
 c.donor_id=b.donor_id and
 d.usps_id=c.usps_id;

 :donors.s_name:=v_name;
 :donors.s_address:=v_address;
 :donors.s_home_phone:=v_house_phone;
 ---:donors.s_bus_phone:=v_buss_phone;
 :donors.s_extension:=v_extension;
 v_ssn:=:donors.ssn;

 :donors.s_ssn:=to_char(floor(v_ssn/1000000),'099')||'-'||
 ltrim(to_char(floor(mod(v_ssn,1000000)/10000),'09'))||'-'||
 ltrim(to_char(mod(v_ssn,10000),'0999'));



 if NVL(length(v_buss_phone), 0) > 2 then /* not to print the hypen alone if no bussiness ph */ 
 :donors.s_bus_phone:=v_buss_phone;
 end if;


 begin
 select description into :donors.s_abo_type from valid_master_codes where code=:donors.blood_type and
 code_type='ABO';
 exception when no_data_found then
 null;
 end;
 :new_donor.blood_type:=:donors.s_abo_type;
 color_change('Y');

 :donors.s_life_don := DON_STD.donor_life_unit_count(:donors.donor_id,:global.chapter_id);
 :donors.s_life_credit := DON_STD.donor_life_credit_count(:donors.donor_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id);

 :donors.s_ytd_don := DON_STD.donor_ytd_unit_count(:donors.donor_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id);
 :donors.s_ytd_credit := DON_STD.donor_ytd_credit_count(:donors.donor_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id);

 Begin
 select coll_date,unit_id,donation_type,procedure_code into :donors.s_last_don_date,
 v_temp_unit_id,:donors.s_don_type,:donors.s_proc_code from
 donations a where donor_id=:donors.donor_id and
 coll_date = (select max(coll_date) from donations where donor_id=:donors.donor_id) and
 rownum=1;

 If v_temp_unit_id is not null then 
 if length(v_temp_unit_id)=13 then 
 VALIDATE_UNIT_CHKDIGIT(v_temp_unit_id,szChkDgt);
 :donors.s_unit:=v_temp_unit_id||ltrim(szChkDgt);
 else
 :donors.s_unit:=v_temp_unit_id;
 end if;
 End If;
 
 Exception when no_data_found then
 null;
 End;
 
 DONOR_SINCE;
 
 v_gallons:=floor(:donors.s_life_credit/8);
 :donors.s_life_gallon:=v_gallons;
 :donors.s_nxt_gallon:=gallons(:donors.s_life_credit);
 if v_gallons>=1 then
 begin
 select DISTINCT parameter_value
 into v_gallon_file
 from valid_parameters
 where --chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 parameter_type = 'ALL'
 and parameter_code = 'GALLON_IMG';
 read_image_file(v_gallon_file, 'ALL','donors.gallon_pin');
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 message('Gallon Image file not specified in Parameters');
 end;
 end if;


 EXCEPTION when no_data_found then
 null;
 END;

 ltrim(to_char(mod(n_ssn,10000),'0999'));

*/

PROCEDURE PRINT_DONOR_CARD(pl_session_id in varchar2) IS
parameters VARCHAR2(150) := NULL;
 command VARCHAR2(200) := NULL;
 temp_return number;
 filename varchar2(1000);
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dest_parm'; 
 rep_dir varchar2(30);
 temp varchar2(40);
 a_port varchar2(40);
 val varchar2(2000);
 repid REPORT_OBJECT;
 v_rep VARCHAR2(100);
 rep_status VARCHAR2(20);
 v_rep_name VARCHAR2(20);
 alert_id number:=0;
--for Apps server 
report_id Report_Object;
ReportServerJob VARCHAR2(100);
vc_rep_status VARCHAR2(100);
vjob_id VARCHAR2(100);

BEGIN 
 BEGIN 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id) ;
 end if ;

 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF; 
 END; 
 --message('number -1');
 
/* Get the report server name from the master code table*/

 BEGIN
 Select code_desc into val 
 from master_codes 
 where code_type='OASVR' 
 and code='RPSVR'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1); 
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 message('Report server is not defined in the SYSPARM table for REPSVR');
 raise form_trigger_failure; 
 End; 

 -- get the report name
 
 begin

 select parameter_value into v_rep_name from valid_parameters
 where upper(parameter_code)='FCARD';
 --and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception 

 when no_data_found then
 show_error('16205');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 message(sqlerrm);pause; 
 check_package_failure; 
 end;
 
 
filename:=v_rep_name||pl_session_id||LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid||'.pdf'; 
report_id:= find_report_object('LTREPORTS');
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_FILENAME,lower(v_rep_name)); --'vdrinter.rdf');
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_COMM_MODE,ASYNCHRONOUS);
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_EXECUTION_MODE,BATCH);
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESTYPE,file);
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESNAME,filename);
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESFORMAT,'pdf');
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_SERVER,val);
SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_OTHER, 'paramform=no');

Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_SESSION',TEXT_PARAMETER,LTRIM(RTRIM(pl_session_id)));
 
ReportServerJob:=run_report_object(report_id,pl_id);
vjob_id := substr(reportserverjob,length(val)+2);
vc_rep_status := REPORT_OBJECT_STATUS(ReportServerJob);
--message('Status='||vc_rep_status);

WHILE vc_rep_status in ('RUNNING','OPENING_REPORT','ENQUEUED', null)
LOOP
vc_rep_status:=REPORT_OBJECT_STATUS(ReportServerJob);
END LOOP;

IF vc_rep_status='FINISHED' THEN
 
 -- if nvl(:global.status,' ')='Y' OR :global.action='NEW' then --- from post-query of valid_proc_codes
 -- set_alert_property('inform_alert',alert_message_text,'Donor card generated in the PDF file, please print'); 
 -- alert_id:=show_alert('inform_alert');
 WEB.SHOW_DOCUMENT('/reports/rwservlet/getjobid'|| vjob_id ||'?server='||val,'_blank');
-- end if;
 :global.print_status:='YES'; ---used in the key-clrfrm 
 set_item_property('new_donor.print',label,'Reprint');
 --message('Donor Card Generated');
ELSE
 message ('Report failed with error message '|| vc_rep_status);
END IF;
END;
